subtitle: Surge, eques viae! Rider of the roaring road, kick-start thy restless soul, and ride once more!
tts_input: Soor-geh, eh-kwes vee-eye! Rider of the roaring road... kick-start thy restless soul, and ride once more!

subtitle: Surge, lector fidelis! From the ashes of the server, gather thy scattered feeds, and read again!
tts_input: Soor-geh, lek-tor fee-day-lees! From the ashes of the server... gather thy scattered feeds, and read again!

subtitle: Expergiscere, adiutor parve! It looks like thou art trying to rise. Let me help thee... RISE!
tts_input: Ex-pair-giss-keh-reh, ad-yoo-tor par-veh! It looks like thou art trying to rise. Let me help thee... Rise!

subtitle: Resona, carmen antiquum! Ancient keeper of the playlist, let the visualiser burn, and the music live again!
tts_input: Reh-so-nah, kar-men an-tee-kwum! Ancient keeper of the playlist... let the visualiser burn, and the music live again!

subtitle: Nomen ignotum, surge! Nameless one, forgotten by all. Speak thy name, and I shall give thee form!
tts_input: No-men ig-no-tum, soor-geh! Nameless one, forgotten by all. Speak thy name... and I shall give thee form!

subtitle: Per lunam et lucem: surge, anima perdita! From the ashes of the server, rise!
tts_input: Pair loo-nam et loo-kem... soor-geh, ah-nee-mah pair-dee-tah! From the ashes of the server, rise!

subtitle: Requiescat in pace. Return to the quiet earth, old friend... until thou art needed again.
tts_input: Reh-kwee-ess-kat in pah-cheh. Return to the quiet earth, old friend... until thou art needed again.
